# Ansatz

Source: [`Kernel/Ansatz.wl`](../../Kernel/Ansatz.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#ansatz-kernelansatzwl--defineansatz)

DefineAnsatz: parse an MSR action density written with the package operators dt, grad, div, lap into a table of monomials  coefficient x product of (derivatives of single fields). Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Ansatz".

## Symbols

### `dt`

`dt[e]`: time derivative in the ansatz density (package-owned and inert; not System\`Dt).

### `grad`

`grad[e]`: spatial gradient (a vector) in the ansatz density; contract two of them with a dot: `grad[a]`.`grad[b]`.

### `div`

`div[v]`: divergence of a vector expression in the ansatz density, e.g. `div[H grad[Psi]]`.

### `lap`

`lap[e]`: Laplacian in the ansatz density.

### `jac`

`jac[a, b]` = eps\_ij d\_i a d\_j b (eps\_12 = +1) in the ansatz density, a and b scalars. It exists only in d = 2: declare "Dimension" -> `FixedDimension[2]` in DefineTheory. At most one jac per monomial.

### `DefineAnsatz`

`DefineAnsatz[theory, "Density" -> density, "Couplings" -> {c1, c2, ...}]` parses the density (Gamma\_k = Integral dt d^dx density) into monomials, prints the parsed table and returns the "Ansatz" stage.

### `FieldFactor`

`FieldFactor[phi, nt, {i, ...}]` is the factor dt^nt d\_i ... phi of a parsed monomial; every repeated `SpaceIndex[n]` is summed over (one index per contraction, numbered canonically).

### `SpaceIndex`

`SpaceIndex[n]` is a summed spatial index in a parsed monomial.

### `EpsIndex`

`EpsIndex[s]` (s = 1, 2) is the s-th index of eps\_ij in a parsed monomial: `jac[a, b]` gives `EpsIndex[1]` on the factor of a and `EpsIndex[2]` on the factor of b.

### `ShowMonomials`

`ShowMonomials[ansatz]` prints the table of parsed monomials (coefficient \| fields \| operators).

### `MonomialString`

`MonomialString[monomial]` writes the field part of a parsed monomial back in the DSL.

### `fn`

`fn[f, X]` in the ansatz density is f(-Laplacian) acting on X: X is one field, optionally under grad/lap, and f a function declared in DefineAnsatz "Functions" -> {f -> reference}. In Fourier space f takes the momentum of X: in a bilinear term nuk `fn[fnu, lap[h]]` gives nuk p^2 fnu(p^2). An ansatz with fn uses the LO pipeline (design/LOPIPELINE.md).

### `MonomialFunction`

`MonomialFunction[monomial]` is the function f of the fn factor of a parsed monomial, or None.
